description: A normal standup: four categories exercised, three cards created, one duplicate skipped, and a post-write audit that confirms the board matches the plan.
note: This scenario used to assert a category-dispute hold — Pass 2b's blind read disagreeing with Pass 2a across the new-versus-existing boundary. That expectation was removed after three consecutive re-recordings produced three different answers on the same fixture: held, then not, then not. The disagreement is a model judgement, and a cassette can pin what deterministic code does with a reply, never which reply arrives. Every gate, including the category dispute, is proven deterministically instead — 53 cases in contractGates.test.ts and an end-to-end hold in run.test.ts, all with scripted replies. Treating a lucky recording as a guarantee is how a fixture reads as stable for months and then fails for whoever re-records next, at the exact moment it is hardest to tell from a real regression.
